family: The total OR family: L is the set of binary strings that contain at least one 1. For every integer n>=0, f_n:{0,1}^n->{0,1} is f_n(x)=x_1 OR x_2 OR ... OR x_n, with f_0 the constant 0 (the empty string is not in L). Every length is defined by this single rule; there are no blocks, encodings, paddings or per-length parameters, and the actual input length is n=|x|.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family (hence in NP with the empty witness), every B2 circuit computing f_n has at least n-1 gates for every integer n>=1, i.e. C_B2(f_n)>=n-1 at every integer length n>=1 in the full Li-Yang B2 model; therefore liminf_{n->infinity} C_B2(f_n)/n >= 1, so the pair (c,p)=(1,1) holds unconditionally.
